newsitem.title: bangladesh: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Jan 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Jan 28.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
A crucial meeting between India and Bangladesh to resolve outstanding issues relating to cross border insurgency and repatriation of chakma refugees begins in New Delhi on Tuesday.
The cabinet has asked top bureaucrats to identify reasons behind their failure to cut through red-tapism in implementing various government decisions.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina told a visiting U.S official that her government had given top priority to privatisation and attracting foreign direct investment.
Former President H M Ershad has demanded trial of the "corrupt" leaders of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP).
The government has decided to open two Business Advisory Centres in London and New York to attract the British and U.S. investors, specially of Bangladeshi origin.
Visting U.S. Assistant Secretary of State Robin Raphel on Monday appreciated the role of Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina in bringing back the opposition in the parliament.
The cabinet in a meeting on Monday approved a proposal for setting up Bangladesh Land Port Authority for proper management of the country's land ports.

In a fresh move to attract more foreign direct invstment in Bangladesh, the Board of Investment (BOI) plans to organise a number of seminars and roundtables on the investment climate in collaboration with internationally reputed promoters.
